title: Comforting blanket
text: Comforting blanket. This really helps my daughter with anxiety.  It helps to calm her when she is having an attack.  The blanket is a bit on the hot side as expected, but I feel the warmth is part of the comfort.  It weighs 15 lbs, but not too heavy.
